result.informal_description: The function $ f(x) = (1 + x)^a $ has a formal power series expansion at $ 0 $ given by the binomial series $ \sum_{n=0}^\infty \binom{a}{n} x^n $, where $ \binom{a}{n} $ denotes the generalized binomial coefficient $ \frac{a(a-1)\cdots(a-n+1)}{n!} $. This expansion holds in the complex numbers $ \mathbb{C} $ for any $ a \in \mathbb{C} $.

name: fourierCoeff
result.type:
{T : ℝ} →
  [hT : Fact (0 < T)] → {E : Type} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℂ E] → (AddCircle T → E) → ℤ → E
result.value:
:=
  ∫ t : AddCircle T, fourier (-n) t • f t ∂haarAddCircle
result.informal_description: For a function $ f $ from the additive circle $ \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} $ to a complex Banach space $ E $ and an integer $ n $, the $ n $-th Fourier coefficient of $ f $ is defined as the Bochner integral $ \int_{t \in \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}} e^{-i \frac{2\pi n}{T} t} \cdot f(t) \, d\mu(t) $, where $ \mu $ denotes the Haar measure on the additive circle normalized to total mass $ T $.
